sources.title: Association of Pharmaceutical Industry Marketing of Opioid Products With Mortality From Opioid-Related Overdoses
Errors in Results, Table 3, and eTables 2 and 3

correction.summary: Notice reports exchanged payment-count and physician-count estimates and intervals in Results and Table 3, further swapped covariates and supplement columns, and a corrected outcome title. It states broad conclusions survive.

residual.summary: Prescribing-rate prose still ranks payment-count highest, beside corrected point estimates: payments 11.08, physicians 13.59, dollars 1.82.

scope.model_scope_caveat: Methods describe Tobit linear estimates; Results and table use aRR labels. Preserve that discrepancy. Mortality uses another model and outcome.

adjudication.essential_dependency: The narrow reported-point-estimate ranking requires the relevant scoped estimates. Its apparent mismatch is an analytical inference, not an explicit publisher correction of the ranking. An exact historical prerequisite edge is not certified.
scope_limits: No significance-of-difference conclusion follows from sorting point estimates or overlapping intervals.
Do not compare estimates across outcome families or silently repair aRR/Tobit terminology.
Do not infer withdrawal of broad conclusions from a local ranking discrepancy.

authority.documentary_association: Official notice identifies the authored article; present article cross-links the notice and reports correction date.
authority.reason: Unsigned publisher notice and named article authors are distinct observed attribution levels. Cross-linking alone does not prove the existing core's same-authority premise.

blockers: No captured historical article with exact erroneous assertion spans.
No source-certified exact historical essential-AND edge.
adjudication.permitted_use: A present-document inconsistency example or separately specified reading diagnostic, with the scope caveats retained. This is not a natural longitudinal correction replay or evidence of algorithmic gain.
adjudication.historical_reconstruction: A transposition could be inferred from the notice, but no reconstructed prior text or values are emitted as historical observations.

quote_accounting.table_image: Official table-image link opened, but image pixels were not exposed to this reviewer; judgment relies on concordant HTML prose, table, and notice.
